question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"question."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Question"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It means a sentence or phrase that asks for an answer. ((किसी विषय में) प्रश्‍न, सवाल (किसी बात का उत्तर पाने के लिए प्रयुक्त वाक्‍य या वाक्‍यांश)) • **Example**: *I want to ask you a **question**__.* • The correct answer is option 4. • Correct passage: The figure of Arthur first appeared in Welsh poetry in the __late__ sixth and early seventh centuries, a hero who was __said to__ lead the Britons in battle against Saxon invaders. But it wasn’t __until__ the 12th century that he was first tied to this dramatic headland, known as Tintagel. The timeless popularity of the Arthur legend has overshadowed a central, unresolved __question__: Was there really a King Arthur, or at least a historical prototype upon whom Geoffrey's hero is ______ (5) ______? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Establishment"** refers to the act of establishing something or an organization or institution that has been established. (संगठन, बड़ी संस्‍था, प्रतिष्‍ठान) • **"Commotion"** means a state of confused and noisy disturbance. (शोरग़ुल, उत्तेजना, हुल्‍लड़, गड़बड़ी) • **"Mess"** can mean a dirty or untidy state, or a situation that is confused or difficult to deal with. (गंदगी या अव्‍यवस्‍था; गंदा या अव्‍यवस्थित व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु) 46:Te63, The correct answer is **"based."**
